ability_score_note: Point buy 14/12/14/10/13/8 (25 points), then the Soldier background raises Strength by 2 and Constitution by 1. No Ability Score Improvement before level 4.
skill_note: Exactly the four skills of the owner brief: two from the Soldier background and two Fighter picks. The human species Skillful trait, which would add a fifth skill, is not taken here (gap: the brief's four are kept; the rules owner may add one skill without changing any station).

species_traits.resourceful: Heroic Inspiration at the end of every long rest (one reroll of any die he has just rolled, the new roll must be used).
species_traits.versatile: Origin feat Alert: adds the proficiency bonus to initiative.

class_features.fighting_style: Defense (+1 Armor Class while wearing armor)
class_features.tactical_mind: Add 1d10 to a failed ability check (spend a Second Wind use).
class_features.champion_improved_critical: Weapon attacks score a critical hit on a natural 19 or 20.
class_features.champion_remarkable_athlete: SRD 5.2.1 Champion level 3 feature: advantage on Initiative rolls and on Strength (Athletics) checks. Not in the owner brief; flagged for the rules owner (the Athletics and initiative stations roll with advantage unless the rules owner decides otherwise).

hit_points.note: 10 + 2 (CON) at level 1, then 6 + 2 each at levels 2 and 3. Hit points are not tracked in the gauntlet phase.

initiative_modifier.note: Dexterity +1 and Alert +2, with advantage from Remarkable Athlete.

attacks.name: Dagger
attacks.note: Finesse: Dexterity +1 gives only +3 to hit and +1 to damage, so Strength is used.
